# Getting Support for Secure Dialer 📞

Hey everyone! Thank you so much for using **Secure Dialer**! I want to make sure you have the best and smoothest experience with the app.

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Before submitting an issue, please check our **[FAQ in README.md](../README.md#%EF%B8%8F-frequently-asked-questions-faq)** or the **[Wiki FAQ](../wiki/FAQ-and-Troubleshooting.md)** for quick help with:
- Zero-Internet permission & offline privacy
- On-device AES-256 database encryption (SQLCipher & Android KeyStore)
- Setting as Default Phone App & offline Call Screening
- Dual-SIM configuration and T9 predictive search

---

## 🐞 Reporting Bugs & Suggesting Ideas

If you find a bug or have an idea to make Secure Dialer better:

1. **Check Existing Issues:** Browse **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues)** to see if it's already reported.
2. **Submit an Issue:**
   - **[Report a Bug](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**: Please tell me your phone brand/model, Android version, and steps to reproduce the issue.
   - **[Suggest a Feature](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)**: Share your thoughts on new offline privacy features!

---

## 🛡️ Security Vulnerabilities

If you discover a security flaw or privacy leak, please do **not** open a public issue. Email me directly at **`movstore.online@gmail.com`** so we can fix it privately and release an update.

---

## 💬 Discussions & Community

- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions)**: Come say hi, ask questions, share how it runs on your phone, or discuss privacy setups!
- **[Project Wiki](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/wiki)**: Guides and technical documentation.
